custom_analyses.sql: SELECT f.title, count(r.rental_id) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.title ORDER BY rentals DESC
